arguments.content:
CONSOLIDATED AMENDED COMPLAINT
Case No. 2024-CV-20101
Plaintiff, on behalf of a class of shareholders of NovaTech Inc., alleges that Defendants, including NovaTech Inc., John Doe (former CFO), and Jane Smith (current CEO), engaged in securities fraud by materially misrepresenting the company's financial health and regulatory compliance status.

Specifically, Defendants issued false and misleading statements in public filings and investor communications between Q2 2022 and Q4 2023, concealing significant cybersecurity breaches and declining revenue trends. These misrepresentations artificially inflated the stock price, which collapsed upon revelation of the truth, causing substantial losses to investors.

Claims brought under Section 10(b) and Rule 10b-5 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. Plaintiff seeks class certification, compensatory damages, interest, costs, and such other relief as the Court deems just.

Dated: April 9, 2026
Respectfully submitted,
Harrison Blackwell PC
Counsel for Defendants
